tooltip.en-US:
Summons Trusty Cattiva to fight for you
A lovely pal that also helps your mining efforts
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
Its trust empowers it, and improved its 'Punch Flurry'!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤可靠的捣蛋猫为你而战
这个可爱的伙伴还能协助你采矿
按{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}抚摸它！
它对你的信赖使其更加强大，并强化了“连击拳”！

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Trusty Foxparks to fight for you
{InputTrigger_UseOrAttack} to use Foxparks' Huggy Fire skill, shooting flames!
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
Its trust empowers it, and it learned 'Spirit Fire'!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤可靠的火绒狐为你而战
按{InputTrigger_UseOrAttack}施展火绒狐的“拥抱烈焰”技能，喷射火焰！
按{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}抚摸它！
它对你的信赖使其更加强大，并学会了“灵魂之火”！

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Trusty Chillet for a ride!
Empowers your attacks while mounted.
Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam!
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
Its trust empowers it, and increases its speed!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤可靠的疾旋鼬供你骑乘！
骑乘时强化你的攻击。
双击一个方向即可发动“火箭猛击”！
按{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}抚摸它！
它对你的信赖使其更加强大，并提高了速度！
